saw_lines: Motorcycle buyers pick a bike by how it rides, then check the payment plan and trade-in before visiting a dealer.
So the sale turns on the offer, and your ads leave it out, so a new rider has no reason to act.
Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 28 ads mention it. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 18 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 28 ads mention it or any offer. A new rider has no reason to act today. Open three new ads on subscribe and save, with the offer printed on the creative.

The site runs subscribe and save, yet 0 of 30 ads mention a subscription, so repeat buyers get no prompt to save on refills. Run two retention ads aimed at past buyers, with subscription saving as the headline.

0 of 28 ads carry a proof number, so a rider scanning a feed has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it on the creative.

7 ads have run 60 days or more, yet none of the 23 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line. Build the next three ads as variations of the oldest winner, keeping its opening line and swapping in subscribe and save.
